definitions.explanation: A local government administrative office where citizens handle official paperwork such as resident registration, certificates, and various permits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{役所|やくしょ}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the government office to get my resident certificate.

examples.japanese: {役所|やくしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧{5時|ごじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{閉|し}まる→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧。
examples.english: The government office counter closes at 5 PM.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧{役所|やくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しなければならない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After moving, you must file a notification at the government office.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (role, service) + ⟦{所|しょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧ (place). Literally "place of service."

TYPES OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT OFFICES:
- ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧ (city hall)
- ⟦{区役所|くやくしょ}→区役所：21563_kuyakusho⟧ (ward office)
- ⟦{町役場|まちやくば}→町役場：13579_machiyakuba⟧/⟦{村役場|むらやくば}→村役場：24018_murayakuba⟧ (town/village office)
- ⟦{県庁|けんちょう}→県庁：27822_kenchou⟧ (prefectural office)

COMMON PROCEDURES AT {役所|やくしょ}:
- ⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧ (issuing resident certificate)
- ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧⟦{謄本|とうほん}→謄本：29796_touhon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧ (obtaining family register copy)
- ⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧/⟦{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}→転出届：09810_tenshutsutodoke⟧ (moving in/out notification)
- ⟦{印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく}→印鑑登録：07491_inkantouroku⟧ (seal registration)
- ⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧ (marriage registration)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {役所|やくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to file a notification)
- {役所|やくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to complete procedures)
- {役所|やくしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧ (government office counter)

USAGE:
{役所|やくしょ} is the general term for local government offices. In casual conversation, ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧ or ⟦{区役所|くやくしょ}→区役所：21563_kuyakusho⟧ may be shortened to just {役所|やくしょ}.
